Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that the Celtic ruler (Cogidubnus) was “born around AD 43,” conflating the date of the Roman conquest of Britain (AD 43) with the ruler’s birth year, which is not supported by sources and is generally unknown. This faulty premise drove subsequent searches (e.g., “Cogidubnus born AD 43”) and introduced a misleading assumption early in the workflow.
